title: Etale sheaves of sets on a field and discrete Galois sets
statement: Let $K$ be a field [def-pc-field-extension], $K^{\rm sep}$ a separable closure, $G=\operatorname{Gal}(K^{\rm sep}/K)$ with its Krull topology, and $\bar s:\operatorname{Spec}K^{\rm sep}\to\operatorname{Spec}K$ the corresponding geometric point. (i) For a sheaf of sets $F$ on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] of $\operatorname{Spec}K$, the group $G$ acts on the stalk $F_{\bar s}$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] through its action on $\operatorname{Spec}K^{\rm sep}$ over $\operatorname{Spec}K$, and every element of $F_{\bar s}$ has an open stabilizer. The functor $F\mapsto F_{\bar s}$ is an equivalence from the category of sheaves of sets on the small etale site of $\operatorname{Spec}K$ to the category of sets with a $G$-action for which every stabilizer is open. (ii) For an etale $K$-scheme $X$ [def-weil-etale-morphism] in the small etale site, the stalk at $\bar s$ of the sheaf $h_X:U\mapsto\operatorname{Hom}_K(U,X)$ is the $G$-set $\operatorname{Hom}_K(\operatorname{Spec}K^{\rm sep},X)$.
